name: @onlyworlds/sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for the OnlyWorlds API - build world-building applications with type safety

scripts.build: tsup --entry.index src/index.ts --entry.waymark src/waymark/index.ts --entry.convert src/convert/index.ts --entry.folder src/folder/index.ts --entry.mcp src/mcp/index.ts --format esm --clean && tsup --entry.index src/index.ts --format esm --dts-only && tsup --entry.waymark src/waymark/index.ts --format esm --dts-only && tsup --entry.convert src/convert/index.ts --format esm --dts-only && tsup --entry.folder src/folder/index.ts --format esm --dts-only && tsup --entry.mcp src/mcp/index.ts --format esm --dts-only && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/waymark/waymark.css', 'dist/waymark.css')"
scripts.dev: tsup --entry.index src/index.ts --entry.waymark src/waymark/index.ts --entry.convert src/convert/index.ts --entry.folder src/folder/index.ts --entry.mcp src/mcp/index.ts --format esm --dts --watch
scripts.codegen: python codegen/generate_types.py && node codegen/tools.mjs && node codegen/layout_anchors.mjs && node codegen/layout_directions.mjs && python codegen/html_entities.py
scripts.codegen:check: python codegen/generate_types.py --check && node codegen/tools.mjs --check && node codegen/layout_anchors.mjs --check && node codegen/layout_directions.mjs --check && python codegen/html_entities.py --check
scripts.schema:check: npm run schema:verify && npm run codegen:check

author: OnlyWorlds
